title.zh: 韩国下令封锁 27 家未注册海外加密货币交易所的网站，
title.en: South Korea Orders Website Blocks on 27 Unregistered Overseas Crypto Exchanges,

current_state.zh: 韩国金融情报院经韩国媒体与通信标准委员会10月6-7日审议后批准对27家未注册海外加密交易所和虚拟资产服务商的国内网站封锁，包括KuCoin、MEXC、Phemex、Bitrue、BingX、BitMart、Poloniex等，并计划通过DAXA与运营商合作向受影响用户提供提现指引。
current_state.en: South Korea's FIU approved domestic website blocks on 27 unregistered overseas crypto exchanges and VASPs, including KuCoin, MEXC, Phemex, Bitrue, BingX, BitMart and Poloniex, following Korea Media and Communications Standards Commission reviews on Oct. 6–7; it plans to provide withdrawal guidance through DAXA with operator cooperation.

updates.title_zh: 韩国下令封锁 27 家未注册海外加密货币交易所的网站，
updates.title_en: South Korea Orders Website Blocks on 27 Unregistered Overseas Crypto Exchanges,
updates.what_changed_zh: 韩国金融情报院下令对包括 KuCoin、MEXC、BingX、BitMart 和 Poloniex 在内的 27 家未注册海外加密货币交易所实施境内网站封锁，扩大现有的应用层面限制，并将 44 家未注册 VASP 移交调查人员，同时将通过 DAXA 向受影响用户提供提现指引。
updates.what_changed_en: South Korea's Financial Intelligence Unit ordered domestic website blocks on 27 unregistered overseas crypto exchanges including KuCoin, MEXC, BingX, BitMart and Poloniex, expanding existing app-level restrictions and referring 44 unregistered VASPs to investigators, with withdrawal guidance to be provided to affected users through DAXA.

updates.detailed_summary_en: South Korea's Financial Intelligence Unit ordered domestic website blocks on 27 unregistered overseas crypto exchanges including KuCoin, MEXC, BingX, BitMart and Poloniex, expanding existing app-level restrictions and referring 44 unregistered VASPs to investigators, with withdrawal guidance to be provided to affected users through DAXA.

updates.title_zh: 韩国着手封锁包括 KuCoin、MEXC 在内的 27 个加密货币网站
updates.title_en: South Korea moves to block 27 crypto websites, including KuCoin, MEXC
updates.what_changed_zh: FIU的网站封锁措施经韩国媒体与通信标准委员会10月6-7日审议后批准；名单进一步列出Phemex、Bitrue、CoinW、BTCC、DigiFinex等交易所，并说明FIU通过韩语服务、营销和韩元交易等标准判断海外运营商是否面向韩国用户。
updates.what_changed_en: The FIU's website-blocking measures were approved following reviews by the Korea Media and Communications Standards Commission on Oct. 6–7; the list further names exchanges such as Phemex, Bitrue, CoinW, BTCC, and DigiFinex, and the FIU assesses Korean targeting via Korean-language services, marketing, and KRW transactions.
updates.current_state_zh: 韩国金融情报院经韩国媒体与通信标准委员会10月6-7日审议后批准对27家未注册海外加密交易所和虚拟资产服务商的国内网站封锁，包括KuCoin、MEXC、Phemex、Bitrue、BingX、BitMart、Poloniex等，并计划通过DAXA与运营商合作向受影响用户提供提现指引。
updates.current_state_en: South Korea's FIU approved domestic website blocks on 27 unregistered overseas crypto exchanges and VASPs, including KuCoin, MEXC, Phemex, Bitrue, BingX, BitMart and Poloniex, following Korea Media and Communications Standards Commission reviews on Oct. 6–7; it plans to provide withdrawal guidance through DAXA with operator cooperation.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: South Korea's Financial Intelligence Unit approved measures to block domestic access to 27 websites of unregistered crypto exchanges and virtual asset service providers, including KuCoin, MEXC, Phemex and Bitrue, while acknowledging users may face difficulty withdrawing assets.
updates.detailed_summary_en: South Korea's Financial Intelligence Unit approved measures to block domestic access to 27 websites of unregistered crypto exchanges and virtual asset service providers, including KuCoin, MEXC, Phemex and Bitrue, while acknowledging users may face difficulty withdrawing assets.
